stage0091_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「This works out great!
　No idea why, but since we're face to
　face like this, there's only one thing to do...!」

stage0091_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$シルフィ$$'s here too? All the better!
　Listen up, $$アマタ$$!!」

stage0091_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I'm gonna kill $$シルフィ$$!
　We'll kill each other in the name of love!
　Screw the parent who merely gave me birth!」

stage0091_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't accept something like that!」

stage0091_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You're weak...!
　And your love is weak too...!」

stage0091_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That's why, 12,000 years ago,
　we were torn apart from $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0091_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「And now, 12,000 years later in this life,
　you watched your mother go, too...」

stage0091_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カグラ$$
「And this time, $$シルフィ$$ too...!」

stage0091_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The first time I met $$ミコノ$$,
　I felt fate too!
　Someone who'd accept me and share the same pain...!」

stage0091_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But that's not all!
　$$ミコノ$$ gets sulky so easily...!
　She's quick to anger, and jealous for no reason...!」

stage0091_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't you daaare praise that damn woman!!」

stage0091_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But $$ミコノ$$ always gives it her all,
　and she can stand by people's pain!
　She can bring everyone's feelings together!」

stage0091_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's that $$ミコノ$$...
　not $$シルフィ$$, but the $$ミコノ$$ right now, that I...!」

stage0091_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
???
「A world of darkness...
　A place filled with the power of shadow」

stage0091_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
???
「The stellar energy absorbed
　into $$鉄人$$ gained $$正太郎$$'s
　pure will and gave birth to power」

stage0091_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
???
「It annihilated the black hole,
　and destroyed the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$」

stage0091_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
???
「Having used up all its power,
　$$鉄人$$ fell into this world」

stage0091_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「Mars...
　Use your power to guide $$鉄人$$
　to the world of light」

stage0091_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$タケル$$
「Brother...!
　I knew it, it really is you, Brother!」

stage0091_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$タケル$$
「That I could dive into $$グーラ$$'s heart
　was your guidance too, Brother!」

stage0091_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「Hurry, Mars.
　You and I together can bridge
　darkness and light」

stage0091_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「That's our fate...
　The mission of us both, born
　into darkness and light」

stage0091_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$タケル$$
「Brother...!
　I'll give it a try!」

stage0091_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$マーグ#pilot$$
「Fight, Mars...
　My other half, who holds the light...」

stage0091_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's exactly when you're in a mood
　like that, that you oughta drink.
　To forget all the crap you hate」

stage0091_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Why I was drawn to you」

stage0091_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「A man and a woman don't need
　a reason, do they?」

stage0091_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「You're the same as me...
　There's no place for you here」

stage0091_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「A doll, placed in a world
　someone built...
　I... I came to know that...」

stage0091_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「No... I'd known it for a
　long time now. But I thought
　I could live on, looking away from it」

stage0091_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「But he wouldn't accept that」

stage0091_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$, huh...」

stage0091_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「He's a reckless guy too.
　If he'd just lived on without his memories,
　he'd have been free of both pain and sorrow...」

stage0091_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「In you, choosing to live that way,
　I felt something the same as myself...」

stage0091_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「But... I think I'm at my limit...」

stage0091_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「I... I've read it...
　The final chapter of '$$メトロポリス$$'...」

stage0091_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「I want to forget everything...
　Go back to when I knew nothing...」

stage0091_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「$$エンジェル$$...
　A messenger of god... huh...」

stage0091_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Damn...
　The booze is gonna taste bad again...」

stage0091_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even without your original power,
　to battle the Wings of the sun and even
　defeat the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$... I'm truly impressed, everyone.」

stage0091_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That fighting spirit produced 100 Z
　worth of Z-Chips. I'll naturally add
　these to the squad's stock.」

stage0091_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Not really the time to say that.
　We've been in a mad scramble with
　back-to-back battles lately.」

stage0091_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies!
　An emergency's come up, so today
　D-Trader will run on the automatic system!」

stage0091_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for the ace pilot
　will also be carried over to next time!」

stage0091_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I have to say, this is bad...!
　This is an unexpected situation
　even for me! Well then, excuse me!」
